shortDescription: Execute sql (scripts) using sqlplus (BEQ) or catcon.pl

options.name: catcon_pl
options.description: Script name, optionally followed by parameters. Will be executed by $OH//perl catcon.pl

options.name: creates_sql
options.description: This is the check query to ensure idempotence.. Must be a single SQL select that results to no rows or a plain 0 if the catcon_pl/sqlscript/sql has to be executed. Any other result prevent the execution of catcon_pl/sqlscript/sql.. The catcon_pl/sqlscript/sql will be executed unconditionally if creates_sql is omitted.. Creates_sql must be omitted when sqlselect is used.. Creates_sql is executed with sqlplus / as sysdba in the root container. Write the sql query according to this fact.. If pdb_li

options.name: nls_lang
options.description: set NLS_LANG to the given value

options.name: oracle_db_name
options.description: SID or DB_NAME, needed for BEQ connect

options.name: pdb_list
options.description: Optional list of PDB names. Space separated, as catcon.pl wants. Gets used only if scope is "pdbs". Will be automatically filled and used when scope = all_pdbs and action like sql%.

options.name: scope
options.description: Shall the SQL be applied to CDB, PDBs, or both?

options.name: sql
options.description: Single SQL statement. Will be executed by sqlplus. Used for DDL and DML.

options.name: sqlscript
options.description: Script name, optionally followed by parameters. Will be executed by sqlplus

options.name: sqlselect
options.description: Single SQL statement. Will be executed by sqlplus using dbms_xmlgen.getxml. Used for select only, returns dict in .state. To access the column "value" of the first row write: "<<registered result>>.state.ROW[0].VALUE" (use uppercase).

options.name: username
options.description: Database username, defaults to "/ as sysdba"
